policies.title: AI agent tools need a person's approval before deleting or emailing
policies.statement: An AI agent tool must not delete records or send email unless a person has approved the action first. Each tool that deletes a record or sends an email must call request_human_approval before that statement runs, and that call stops the tool until a person approves the request in the back office. This policy checks the order of the calls only; it cannot tell whether the approval function decides correctly.
